the majority of CD8(+) CTL responses to CMV pp65 in healthy individuals sharing HLA-A2 and HLA-B7 alleles are directed at HLA-B7-restricted epitopes and that the immunodominance is maintained in HIV-infected individuals and in patients undergoing stem cell transplantation.

in HLA-A*0201/HLA-B'0702 individuals, the strongest T cell response to CMV is to a B7-restricted epitope, and this is the case both in immunocompetent individuals, and in immunocompromised patients, such as those undergoing haematopoietic stem cell transplantation, or those with HIV infection.

the majority of the HLA-A* 02/B*07 positive healthy individuals had significant responses to HLA-B7-restricted pp65 epitopes, while HLA-A*07-restricted pp65 responses dominated in HLA-A*2/B*07-positive patients with impaired immune function.
